Liam (prod-eng): incident-bot triggered: high error rate on /v1/generate from us-east-1, rolling alert at 80% 3177772222
incident-bot: metric spike: decode_gpu_ooms increased by 18x in last 2m, affected service=streaming-decode, severity=sev2
Liam (prod-eng): paging Priya oncall (pd) :priya: you're it, looks like GPU OOMs during streaming. customer-facing drops reported.
PagerDuty (pager): Paging Priya (SRE, oncall) assigned at 3177772230
Priya (sre): on it. first glance: dozens of node flaps on decode pool 7c, container restarts, CUDA errors in logs. linking sample: `ERR CUDA_ERROR: out of memory at llm_decode.cc:482`
Ivy (runtime-ml): confirmed. We're seeing runaway generation sessions where client max_tokens header is absent and defaults to 1e6 for some SDKs; continuous decoding causes KV growth -> OOM. Session patterns show token rate ~50t/s for long-streams.
Alex (support): Customer Ops flagged support ticket #CS-4821 from big-retailer: intermittent 502s and truncated responses starting ~3177772210. They're seeing spikes in failed streaming requests.
Liam (prod-eng): quant: error rate for streaming endpoints up from 0.3% -> 12% in 6 minutes. 95th latency also jump. Need quick mitigation to reduce surface.
Sam (infra): proposing 3 step play: 1) emergency config to enforce per-request max_tokens header (cap to 2048) at the edge 2) throttle long-lived streams 3) migrate traffic off pool 7c to fallback pool 4A. Can apply policy in routing layer now.
Priya (sre): agree. Applying edge cap now. Command: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/reconfig -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","header_max_tokens":2048}'` 
Priya (sre): applied. pushing rule to ingress. will monitor.
incident-bot: routing-rule applied by Priya at 3177772238. rule_id=r-evict-2048
Ivy (runtime-ml): deploying hotpatch to runtime to enforce server-side max_tokens if header missing. patch will return 400 if client tries to request >2048. rolling to decode fleet 7c.
Sam (infra): starting live migration: `reroute --from pool=7c --to pool=4A --drain-connections 30s`
Liam (prod-eng): FYI: fallback model 1.3-quant is available in pool 4A; slightly higher latency but much lower mem. Good fallback for now.
Priya (sre): watching OOM metric. decode_gpu_ooms dropping after ingress cap. current OOM rate down from 18x -> 2x.
Ivy (runtime-ml): some sessions still causing container restarts due to already-allocated KV caches. Scheduling node drains for hot nodes: node ids n-172,n-173.
Sam (infra): nodes drained and cordoned at 3177772250. restarting containers on those nodes with increased cgroup mem safety margin.
Alex (support): telling the customer: "We've applied emergency mitigations (request cap + reroute) and are investigating root cause; you may see fewer failures now. Follow-up ticket CS-4821 updated."
Customer Ops: thanks. they want ETA for full resolution + retrospective. asking if any data lost.
Ivy (runtime-ml): no data lost from durable stores; some in-flight streams were truncated and returned 502/499, we will correlate logs and provide sample request ids.
Priya (sre): finalizing post-incident actions: 1) telemetry alert for missing/absent max_tokens header to catch SDK regressions 2) conservative default max_tokens on server side 3) throttle policy for streaming endpoints 4) add unit test for runaway-session KV growth in runtime repo.
Liam (prod-eng): can we add a temporary per-customer rate limit for big-retailer until SDK updated? they are the highest contributor to long sessions.
Alex (support): added note to CS-4821 to offer dedicated support window and a rollback plan if we see recurrence.
Priya (sre): handoff to oncall follow-up: assigning to Ivy and Sam for next 4 hours for remediation + RCA. Priya going to incident review.
Priya (sre): closing pager at 3177772260. if error rate rises reopen. :white_check_mark:
Ivy (runtime-ml): quick log snippet for RCA: ```
[3177772219] session_id=abc123 receive_chunk size=4096 total_tokens=524288
[3177772220] kv_cache.bytes=12.8GB exceed threshold 12GB -> OOM
[3177772220] ERR CUDA_ERROR: out of memory at llm_decode.cc:482
```
Liam (prod-eng): next steps: schedule hotfix to set server default max_tokens=2048, add SDK advisory, and run load test for streaming long sessions.
Alex (support): will draft customer-facing summary and share in support channel.
Customer Ops: appreciated, awaiting RCA and timeline.
incident-bot: incident closed by Priya at 3177772260 (duration ~38s). logs and timeline archived to incident-3177772222
